item.title: Bjorn Lomborg: The USA Should Keep Funding the IPCC
item.description: Apparently the IPCC is the main bulwark *against* climate alarmism?

item.title: A BRILLIANT take on cows, methane, and climate
item.description: While cattle do belch methane, it is actually part of an important natural cycle, known as the biogenic carbon cycle.

item.title: Dutch climate skeptics vindicated: KNMI reinstates seven pre-1950 heatwaves after long battle
item.description: Seven years after Dutch skeptics first challenged KNMI’s temperature adjustments, the institute has reinstated seven “lost” pre-1950 heatwaves at De Bilt — validating claims of over-correction that had erased 16 out of 23 historical extremes. The breakthrough came via the skeptics’ peer-reviewed paper.

item.title: Climate Scientist Who Predicted End Of “Heavy Frost and Snow” Now Refuses Media Inquiries
item.description: According to the Berliner Zeitung, the former Max Planck Institute scientist has recently stopped responding to media inquiries regarding his past claims. Critics argue that such drastic predictions damage the credibility of climate science, while others point out that extreme weather events—including intense cold snaps—can still occur within the broader context of climate change.

item.title: True, Mother Jones, Polar Bears Are More Adaptable Than Alarmists Have Claimed
item.description: Mother Jones is one of the premier climate alarmist websites, so it is refreshing, even somewhat surprising, to see it publish any good news at all, even if the good news is framed as surprising with readers directed towards additional alarmist projections with little connection to reality.

item.title: Zombie Carbon Taxes – The Climate Realism Show #189
item.description: A spending bill that passed the Senate recently included a provision directing the Department of Energy to review the “carbon intensity” of American-made products and compare the CO2 emissions with similar products imported to the United States. Such provisions are how carbon taxes, or even carbon tariffs, come to life. What’s going on here? And can this be stopped?

item.title: Meta’s Nuclear Bet Is an Endorsement of Trump’s Energy Vision
item.description: Donald Trump’s call for “American energy dominance” once drew eyerolling from Silicon Valley. Now, in a twist no one saw coming, Meta and other big-tech AI giants are beginning to embrace Trump’s energy vision.

item.title: Republicans Let ‘Carbon Tax Framework’ Slip Through Funding Bill, Opponents Warn
item.description: A directive buried in January “minibus” materials is the first step toward carbon taxes or tariffs, several energy policy experts told the Daily Caller News Foundation.

item.title: Virginia Has No Reason to Rejoin RGGI
item.description: In announcing plans to have Virginia reinstitute a carbon tax, Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger makes no mention of global warming – the bogeyman usually called upon by supporters of such levies. That may be because the apocalyptic narrative that industrial emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2) threaten to overheat the planet has become widely seen as bogus – perhaps not fitting for a newly elected chief executive.

item.title: Germany’s Natural Gas Storage Level Dwindles To Just 28%… Increasingly Critical
item.description: Politicians, media lying about “harsh winter” being the cause of the shortage… Reality: Mismanagement is to blame…Germany was never even prepared for a WARM winter!
